title: DECISION: fail-closed admin endpoint (non-loopback requires bearer token)
description: config.rs check_admin_addr() refuses to start the daemon if the admin HTTP endpoint is bound to a non-loopback address without a bearer token. The default addr is 127.0.0.1:9090 (loopback-only). This is fail-closed: an operator who binds the admin port to 0.0.0.0 without setting a token gets an explicit startup error rather than silently exposing an unauthenticated admin API to the network. Tests verify all four combinations (loopback/non-loopback × token/no-token).
